game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Frost Peaks – Summit Spire, the highest spire: the mountaineer must handle storm winds while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – F-String Herald: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements.
theme: Frost Peaks – Summit Spire: the highest spire
core_gameplay_loop: In Summit Spire, repeat each round: Format messages with f-strings that insert live values for announcements. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the announcements value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about announcements to power up the mountaineer and open the supply cache.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 2 (intro tier): F-String Herald
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'F-String Herald' (Week 8 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Summit Spire'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how announcements changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against storm winds in Summit Spire.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
